prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH scoped_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
scoped_order_items AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.total_amount
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN scoped_orders so ON so.order_id = oi.order_id
),
order_totals AS (
    SELECT soi.order_id,
           SUM(soi.total_amount) AS order_revenue
    FROM scoped_order_items soi
    GROUP BY soi.order_id
),
base_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(order_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_totals
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT soi.order_id, soi.product_id
    FROM scoped_order_items soi
),
product_baseline AS (
    SELECT op.product_id,
           COUNT(*) AS product_order_count,
           COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT order_count FROM base_orders) AS product_frequency_rate
    FROM order_products op
    GROUP BY op.product_id
),
pair_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.order_id,
           a.product_id AS product_id_1,
           b.product_id AS product_id_2
    FROM order_products a
    JOIN order_products b
      ON a.order_id = b.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
),
pair_metrics AS (
    SELECT po.product_id_1,
           po.product_id_2,
           COUNT(*) AS support,
           COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT order_count FROM base_orders) AS frequency_rate,
           SUM(ot.order_revenue) AS sales_contribution,
           SUM(ot.order_revenue) / (SELECT total_revenue FROM base_orders) AS bundle_revenue_share,
           (COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT order_count FROM base_orders)) /
           NULLIF((pb1.product_frequency_rate * pb2.product_frequency_rate), 0) AS lift,
           COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(pb1.product_order_count, 0) AS confidence
    FROM pair_orders po
    JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = po.order_id
    JOIN product_baseline pb1 ON pb1.product_id = po.product_id_1
    JOIN product_baseline pb2 ON pb2.product_id = po.product_id_2
    GROUP BY po.product_id_1, po.product_id_2, pb1.product_order_count, pb1.product_frequency_rate, pb2.product_frequency_rate
),
top_pairs AS (
    SELECT pm.*
    FROM pair_metrics pm
    ORDER BY pm.support DESC, pm.product_id_1, pm.product_id_2
    LIMIT 20
),
final_rows AS (
    SELECT 0 AS sort_group,
           'overall' AS row_type,
           NULL::text AS product_name_1,
           NULL::text AS product_name_2,
           bo.order_count,
           bo.total_revenue,
           NULL::integer AS support,
           NULL::numeric AS frequency_rate,
           NULL::numeric AS sales_contribution,
           NULL::numeric AS bundle_revenue_share,
           NULL::numeric AS lift,
           NULL::numeric AS confidence,
           NULL::numeric AS baseline_frequency_1,
           NULL::numeric AS baseline_frequency_2
    FROM base_orders bo
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1 AS sort_group,
           'pair' AS row_type,
           p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
           p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
           NULL::bigint AS order_count,
           NULL::numeric AS total_revenue,
           tp.support,
           tp.frequency_rate,
           tp.sales_contribution,
           tp.bundle_revenue_share,
           tp.lift,
           tp.confidence,
           pb1.product_frequency_rate AS baseline_frequency_1,
           pb2.product_frequency_rate AS baseline_frequency_2
    FROM top_pairs tp
    JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = tp.product_id_1
    JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = tp.product_id_2
    JOIN product_baseline pb1 ON pb1.product_id = tp.product_id_1
    JOIN product_baseline pb2 ON pb2.product_id = tp.product_id_2
)
SELECT row_type,
       product_name_1,
       product_name_2,
       order_count,
       total_revenue,
       support,
       frequency_rate,
       sales_contribution,
       bundle_revenue_share,
       lift,
       confidence,
       baseline_frequency_1,
       baseline_frequency_2
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY sort_group, support DESC NULLS LAST, product_name_1, product_name_2;

WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           SUM(oi.total_amount) AS order_total_revenue
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT fo.order_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_item_count
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    JOIN retail.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = fo.order_id
    GROUP BY fo.order_id
),
base_item_freq AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS item_order_count
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
bundles_3 AS (
    SELECT a.order_id,
           a.product_id AS product_id_1,
           b.product_id AS product_id_2,
           c.product_id AS product_id_3,
           SUM(a.total_amount + b.total_amount + c.total_amount) AS bundle_sales_contribution
    FROM retail.order_items a
    JOIN retail.order_items b
      ON a.order_id = b.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN retail.order_items c
      ON a.order_id = c.order_id
     AND b.product_id < c.product_id
    JOIN filtered_orders fo
      ON fo.order_id = a.order_id
    GROUP BY a.order_id, a.product_id, b.product_id, c.product_id
),
bundle_support AS (
    SELECT product_id_1,
           product_id_2,
           product_id_3,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support,
           SUM(bundle_sales_contribution) AS sales_contribution
    FROM bundles_3
    GROUP BY product_id_1, product_id_2, product_id_3
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM filtered_orders
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(order_total_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_revenue
)
SELECT p1.product_name AS item_1,
       p2.product_name AS item_2,
       p3.product_name AS item_3,
       bs.support,
       ROUND(bs.support::numeric / to1.order_count, 6) AS frequency_rate,
       ROUND(bs.sales_contribution, 2) AS sales_contribution,
       ROUND(bs.sales_contribution / tr.total_revenue, 6) AS bundle_revenue_share,
       ROUND(bf1.item_order_count::numeric / to1.order_count, 6) AS baseline_frequency_item_1,
       ROUND(bf2.item_order_count::numeric / to1.order_count, 6) AS baseline_frequency_item_2,
       ROUND(bf3.item_order_count::numeric / to1.order_count, 6) AS baseline_frequency_item_3
FROM bundle_support bs
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = bs.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = bs.product_id_2
JOIN retail.products p3 ON p3.product_id = bs.product_id_3
JOIN base_item_freq bf1 ON bf1.product_id = bs.product_id_1
JOIN base_item_freq bf2 ON bf2.product_id = bs.product_id_2
JOIN base_item_freq bf3 ON bf3.product_id = bs.product_id_3
CROSS JOIN total_orders to1
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
ORDER BY bs.support DESC, bs.sales_contribution DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS order_revenue
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, p.product_name
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS product_order_count
    FROM order_products
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT
        a.product_name AS product_name_1,
        b.product_name AS product_name_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS co_purchase_pair_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_orders) AS pair_frequency_rate,
        SUM(orv.order_revenue) AS sales_contribution,
        SUM(orv.order_revenue)::numeric / (SELECT SUM(order_revenue) FROM order_revenue) AS bundle_revenue_share,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_orders)::numeric *
            (pc1.product_order_count::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_orders)) *
            (pc2.product_order_count::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_orders)), 0) AS lift,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS support,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(pc2.product_order_count, 0) AS confidence
    FROM order_products a
    JOIN order_products b
      ON a.order_id = b.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN order_revenue orv
      ON orv.order_id = a.order_id
    JOIN product_counts pc1 ON pc1.product_id = a.product_id
    JOIN product_counts pc2 ON pc2.product_id = b.product_id
    GROUP BY a.product_name, b.product_name, pc1.product_order_count, pc2.product_order_count
),
bundles AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS bundle_size,
        STRING_AGG(op.product_name, ' | ' ORDER BY op.product_name) AS bundle_name
    FROM order_products op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
bundle_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        b.bundle_name,
        b.bundle_size,
        COUNT(*) AS co_purchase_bundle_count,
        COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_orders) AS bundle_frequency_rate,
        SUM(orv.order_revenue) AS sales_contribution,
        SUM(orv.order_revenue)::numeric / (SELECT SUM(order_revenue) FROM order_revenue) AS bundle_revenue_share,
        COUNT(*) AS support
    FROM bundles b
    JOIN order_revenue orv ON orv.order_id = b.order_id
    GROUP BY b.bundle_name, b.bundle_size
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'pair' AS metric_type, product_name_1, product_name_2, NULL::text AS bundle_name,
           co_purchase_pair_count, NULL::integer AS co_purchase_bundle_count,
           pair_frequency_rate, NULL::numeric AS bundle_frequency_rate,
           sales_contribution, bundle_revenue_share, lift, support, confidence, NULL::integer AS bundle_size
    FROM pairs
    ORDER BY support DESC, sales_contribution DESC
    LIMIT 10
) p
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'bundle' AS metric_type, NULL::text AS product_name_1, NULL::text AS product_name_2, bundle_name,
           NULL::integer AS co_purchase_pair_count, co_purchase_bundle_count,
           NULL::numeric AS pair_frequency_rate, bundle_frequency_rate,
           sales_contribution, bundle_revenue_share, NULL::numeric AS lift, support, NULL::numeric AS confidence, bundle_size
    FROM bundle_metrics
    ORDER BY support DESC, sales_contribution DESC
    LIMIT 10
) b
ORDER BY metric_type, support DESC, sales_contribution DESC;

WITH store_map AS (
    SELECT store_id, store_name
    FROM retail.stores
    WHERE store_name IN (
        'Zava Retail Seattle',
        'Zava Retail Bellevue',
        'Zava Retail Tacoma',
        'Zava Retail Spokane',
        'Zava Retail Everett',
        'Zava Retail Redmond',
        'Zava Retail Kirkland',
        'Zava Retail Online'
    )
),
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, s.store_name
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN store_map s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
),
order_pair_flags AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.order_id, a.store_id, LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1, GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items a
    JOIN retail.order_items b
      ON a.order_id = b.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
),
store_pair_orders AS (
    SELECT so.store_name, opf.order_id, opf.product_id_1, opf.product_id_2
    FROM order_pair_flags opf
    JOIN store_orders so
      ON opf.order_id = so.order_id
     AND opf.store_id = so.store_id
),
overall_order_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM retail.orders
),
overall_pair_order_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pair_order_count
    FROM order_pair_flags
),
store_order_counts AS (
    SELECT store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_order_count
    FROM store_orders
    GROUP BY 1
),
store_pair_counts AS (
    SELECT store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT (order_id, product_id_1, product_id_2)) AS store_pair_count
    FROM store_pair_orders
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    soc.store_name,
    soc.store_order_count,
    COALESCE(spc.store_pair_count, 0) AS store_pair_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(spc.store_pair_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(soc.store_order_count, 0), 6) AS store_pair_frequency_rate,
    ROUND((COALESCE(spc.store_pair_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(soc.store_order_count, 0)) - (opoc.pair_order_count::numeric / NULLIF(oc.order_count, 0)), 6) AS deviation_from_baseline,
    ROUND(opoc.pair_order_count::numeric / NULLIF(oc.order_count, 0), 6) AS overall_pair_frequency_rate
FROM store_order_counts soc
CROSS JOIN overall_order_count oc
CROSS JOIN overall_pair_order_count opoc
LEFT JOIN store_pair_counts spc ON soc.store_name = spc.store_name
ORDER BY soc.store_name;

WITH year_orders AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS season_order_count
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
    GROUP BY 1
),
year_pair_support AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS season_pair_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            o.order_id,
            LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1,
            GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2
        FROM retail.order_items a
        JOIN retail.order_items b
          ON a.order_id = b.order_id
         AND a.product_id < b.product_id
        JOIN retail.orders o
          ON o.order_id = a.order_id
        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
    ) pairs
    JOIN retail.orders o
      ON o.order_id = pairs.order_id
    GROUP BY 1
),
overall_pair_support AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS overall_pair_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            o.order_id,
            LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1,
            GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2
        FROM retail.order_items a
        JOIN retail.order_items b
          ON a.order_id = b.order_id
         AND a.product_id < b.product_id
        JOIN retail.orders o
          ON o.order_id = a.order_id
        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
    ) pairs
),
overall_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS overall_order_count
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
)
SELECT
    yo.order_year,
    yo.season_order_count,
    COALESCE(yps.season_pair_count, 0) AS season_pair_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(yps.season_pair_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(yo.season_order_count, 0), 6) AS season_pair_frequency_rate,
    ROUND((COALESCE(yps.season_pair_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(yo.season_order_count, 0)) - (ops.overall_pair_count::numeric / NULLIF(oo.overall_order_count, 0)), 6) AS deviation_from_baseline
FROM year_orders yo
LEFT JOIN year_pair_support yps
  ON yps.order_year = yo.order_year
CROSS JOIN overall_pair_support ops
CROSS JOIN overall_orders oo
ORDER BY yo.order_year;

WITH order_scope AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year, s.store_name
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM order_scope
),
store_orders AS (
    SELECT store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS segment_order_count
    FROM order_scope
    GROUP BY 1
),
year_orders AS (
    SELECT order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS segment_order_count
    FROM order_scope
    GROUP BY 1
),
pair_orders AS (
    SELECT
        os.order_id,
        os.store_name,
        os.order_year,
        LEAST(p1.product_name, p2.product_name) AS item_1,
        GREATEST(p1.product_name, p2.product_name) AS item_2
    FROM order_scope os
    JOIN retail.order_items a ON a.order_id = os.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b ON b.order_id = os.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
),
bundle_orders AS (
    SELECT
        os.order_id,
        os.store_name,
        os.order_year,
        CASE
            WHEN p1.product_name <= p2.product_name AND p1.product_name <= p3.product_name THEN p1.product_name
            WHEN p2.product_name <= p1.product_name AND p2.product_name <= p3.product_name THEN p2.product_name
            ELSE p3.product_name
        END AS item_1,
        CASE
            WHEN (p1.product_name >= p2.product_name AND p1.product_name <= p3.product_name) OR (p1.product_name >= p3.product_name AND p1.product_name <= p2.product_name) THEN p1.product_name
            WHEN (p2.product_name >= p1.product_name AND p2.product_name <= p3.product_name) OR (p2.product_name >= p3.product_name AND p2.product_name <= p1.product_name) THEN p2.product_name
            ELSE p3.product_name
        END AS item_2,
        CASE
            WHEN p1.product_name >= p2.product_name AND p1.product_name >= p3.product_name THEN p1.product_name
            WHEN p2.product_name >= p1.product_name AND p2.product_name >= p3.product_name THEN p2.product_name
            ELSE p3.product_name
        END AS item_3
    FROM order_scope os
    JOIN retail.order_items a ON a.order_id = os.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b ON b.order_id = os.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN retail.order_items c ON c.order_id = os.order_id AND b.product_id < c.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p3 ON p3.product_id = c.product_id
),
overall_pair AS (
    SELECT item_1, item_2, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM pair_orders
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
overall_bundle AS (
    SELECT item_1, item_2, item_3, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM bundle_orders
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
segment_pair AS (
    SELECT 'store_location_vs_store_location' AS comparison_type, store_name AS segment_value, 'pair' AS bundle_type, item_1, item_2, NULL::text AS item_3, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM pair_orders GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'season_year_vs_season_year' AS comparison_type, order_year::text AS segment_value, 'pair' AS bundle_type, item_1, item_2, NULL::text AS item_3, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM pair_orders GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
segment_bundle AS (
    SELECT 'store_location_vs_store_location' AS comparison_type, store_name AS segment_value, 'bundle' AS bundle_type, item_1, item_2, item_3, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM bundle_orders GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'season_year_vs_season_year' AS comparison_type, order_year::text AS segment_value, 'bundle' AS bundle_type, item_1, item_2, item_3, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS support
    FROM bundle_orders GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        sp.comparison_type,
        sp.segment_value,
        sp.bundle_type,
        sp.item_1,
        sp.item_2,
        sp.item_3,
        sp.support AS segment_support,
        CASE WHEN sp.comparison_type = 'store_location_vs_store_location' THEN so.segment_order_count ELSE yo.segment_order_count END AS segment_order_count,
        ROUND(sp.support::numeric / NULLIF(CASE WHEN sp.comparison_type = 'store_location_vs_store_location' THEN so.segment_order_count ELSE yo.segment_order_count END,0), 6) AS segment_frequency_rate,
        CASE WHEN sp.bundle_type = 'pair' THEN op.support ELSE ob.support END AS overall_support,
        ROUND((CASE WHEN sp.bundle_type = 'pair' THEN op.support ELSE ob.support END)::numeric / NULLIF(oc.total_orders,0), 6) AS overall_frequency_rate,
        ROUND((sp.support::numeric / NULLIF(CASE WHEN sp.comparison_type = 'store_location_vs_store_location' THEN so.segment_order_count ELSE yo.segment_order_count END,0)) - ((CASE WHEN sp.bundle_type = 'pair' THEN op.support ELSE ob.support END)::numeric / NULLIF(oc.total_orders,0)), 6) AS deviation_from_baseline,
        ROUND((sp.support::numeric / NULLIF(CASE WHEN sp.comparison_type = 'store_location_vs_store_location' THEN so.segment_order_count ELSE yo.segment_order_count END,0)) / NULLIF(((CASE WHEN sp.bundle_type = 'pair' THEN op.support ELSE ob.support END)::numeric / NULLIF(oc.total_orders,0)),0), 6) AS lift
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM segment_pair
        UNION ALL
        SELECT * FROM segment_bundle
    ) sp
    LEFT JOIN store_orders so ON so.store_name = sp.segment_value AND sp.comparison_type = 'store_location_vs_store_location'
    LEFT JOIN year_orders yo ON yo.order_year::text = sp.segment_value AND sp.comparison_type = 'season_year_vs_season_year'
    LEFT JOIN overall_pair op ON sp.bundle_type = 'pair' AND op.item_1 = sp.item_1 AND op.item_2 = sp.item_2
    LEFT JOIN overall_bundle ob ON sp.bundle_type = 'bundle' AND ob.item_1 = sp.item_1 AND ob.item_2 = sp.item_2 AND ob.item_3 = sp.item_3
    CROSS JOIN order_counts oc
    WHERE sp.support >= 3
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY comparison_type, bundle_type ORDER BY ABS(deviation_from_baseline) DESC, segment_support DESC) AS rn
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    comparison_type,
    segment_value,
    bundle_type,
    item_1,
    item_2,
    item_3,
    segment_support,
    segment_order_count,
    segment_frequency_rate,
    overall_support,
    overall_frequency_rate,
    deviation_from_baseline,
    lift
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY comparison_type, bundle_type, rn;
